candidates.name: Dual Data Alignment (DDA)

paper.title: Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection by Dual Data Alignment

trainingDomains: DDA aligned real and VAE-reconstructed image pairs

runtime.deviceClass: CUDA GPU with resident DINOv2-L/14 worker
runtime.admission: single inference per resident worker with bounded Node queue

outputSchema.scoreSemantics: sigmoid probability-like score; larger supports AI-generated direction
outputSchema.thresholdSemantics: official evaluation default 0.5; not calibrated for this deployment

artifacts.source: operator-configured local artifact originally published by the authors

license.weights: locally trained universal-v2 checkpoint; source and dataset review retained

productionEligibility.reason: Local route is runnable only as supporting evidence until deployment-domain evaluation and calibration pass.

notes: The active engineering route is universal-v2-medium-all-types-seed5291-v6-step7200; offline test AUC was 0.9398 and balanced direction score was 0.8693.
The active checkpoint is not deployment-calibrated and remains supporting-only for AI adjudication.
Negative output does not prove authenticity.
The detector cannot independently change the deterministic provenance-first verdict.

candidates.name: Simple Preserved and Augmented FEatures (SAFE)

paper.title: Improving Synthetic Image Detection Towards Generalization: An Image Transformation Perspective

trainingDomains: crop-preserved and augmented local artifact features
truncated ResNet-50 with high-frequency wavelet preprocessing
candidates.signalFamily: local high-frequency wavelet artifacts with crop-preserved CNN features

steps: center crop to 256x256 using torchvision CenterCrop padding semantics for smaller inputs
convert pixels to an unnormalized tensor in [0,1]
apply the released bior1.3 high-frequency DWT path inside the model

runtime.deviceClass: CUDA GPU with resident lightweight SAFE worker
runtime.admission: single inference per resident worker with bounded Node queue

outputSchema.scoreSemantics: softmax class-1 probability-like score; larger supports AI-generated direction
outputSchema.thresholdSemantics: official evaluation uses class-1 score strictly greater than 0.5; not calibrated for this deployment

license.weights: Author-published checkpoint included in the Apache-2.0 repository
license.backbone: Not applicable; released checkpoint is a self-contained truncated ResNet

productionEligibility.reason: Apache-2.0 assets are runnable, but deployment-domain fixed-FPR calibration, held-out-generator validation, and robustness gates have not passed.

notes: Local prior evaluation reported strong DiTFake and GenImage results but severe real-image false positives on some CNNDetection subsets such as CRN and IMLE.
Negative output does not prove authenticity and positive output does not prove origin.
The detector cannot independently change the deterministic provenance-first verdict.

candidates.name: MIRROR

paper.title: MIRROR: Manifold Ideal Reference ReconstructOR for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection

candidates.signalFamily: real-manifold reference reconstruction with memory-bank perplexity and residual comparison

steps: resize the short side to 512 only when it exceeds 512 pixels
JPEG-align PNG, BMP, and TIFF inputs at quality 96
convert to tensor; the model applies ImageNet normalization

runtime.deviceClass: CUDA GPU for DINOv3-H+/16 plus phase-1 memory bank
runtime.admission: resident worker with bounded single-device admission and a maximum queued-request count

outputSchema.scoreSemantics: forgery probability from reconstruction perplexity and comparison residual
outputSchema.thresholdSemantics: repository inference uses a binary probability boundary; deployment calibration is absent

license.code: No repository license file as of verification date

productionEligibility.reason: Inference assets are public, but MIRROR code and checkpoint licensing is not stated and local calibration is absent.

notes: This is MIRROR, not the unrelated local MiraGe detector.
All local runtime assets are pinned by SHA-256 and the source revision is checked before worker startup.
It can run only with an explicit non-production operator override and cannot establish an authoritative verdict.

candidates.name: Real-Centric Envelope Modeling (REM)

paper.title: Beyond Artifacts: Real-Centric Envelope Modeling for Reliable AI-Generated Image Detection

trainingDomains: real-only MSCOCO with VAE latent perturbation near-real samples
candidates.signalFamily: real-manifold envelope estimation with cross-domain consistency

steps: resize images larger than 512x512 proportionally to short side 512

runtime.deviceClass: paper specifies DINOv3-H+/16 CUDA training and inference
runtime.admission: not admitted because inference artifacts are not released

outputSchema.scoreSemantics: binary real-envelope classification score; executable semantics not released

license.code: README states MIT for future code, but no implementation or license file is present

productionEligibility.reason: The official repository has no training code, inference code, or checkpoint release.

notes: The released RealChain dataset is CC BY-NC 4.0 and is not a commercial training asset.
Re-evaluate only after the authors publish executable artifacts and explicit licenses.
